cands.name: Steve Byers
cands.bio: Republican. Self-described serial entrepreneur: computer engineering background, technology consulting, aviation, real estate, education, beekeeping and insurance businesses. Homeschools his two children. First-time candidate.
cands.local_ties: Raises a family in Delray Beach (his campaign site).

cands.name: Kelly Skidmore
cands.bio: Democrat incumbent. Born 1962 in Cleveland, raised in Florida from 1972. Served in the Florida House 2006-2010, returned in 2020 (HD 81, now HD 92). Former legislative aide to Sen. Ron Klein and Arthritis Foundation advocacy executive.
cands.local_ties: Boca Raton area (Wikipedia); in Florida since 1972.

record.text: Among House Democrats named in an Aug 2026 advisory committee opposing Amendment 3 (a property tax measure the group calls a tax shift).

endorsements.text: Florida Planned Parenthood PAC 2026 slate of Democratic incumbents.

cands.gaps: No campaign website, donor reporting or endorsements verified. Wikipedia's career dates conflict internally (2006-2008 vs 2006-2010), so treat prior-service years as approximate. Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.
Building Safety (condo safety response after Surfside).
